youtube_title: Rs 100 Off Your First Order: Free Money or the Price of Buying YOU? They're Tricking You #6 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #6. A new app gives you Rs 100 off your first order. Is that discount a loss for the company? A: yes. B: no, it's the price of buying you.
Answer: B. It's called customer acquisition cost - what a company spends to win one new customer. Harvard Business Review notes that getting a new customer can cost 5 to 25 times more than keeping an existing one. So the first order is cheap to build a habit; the money is made on the orders after that. Take the discount, not the habit - compare prices before you order.
Source: Harvard Business Review, 'The Value of Keeping the Right Customers' (2014).
Education only, not financial advice.
